en-US.description: A local-first AI workspace for multi-agent chat, coding, and visual workflows.
en-US.longDescription: A local-first AI workspace for multi-agent chat, coding, and visual workflows. Available as a desktop app and self-hosted web console, with support for Hermes Agent, Ekko Agent, and 14 coding-agent integrations, including Claude Code and Codex. Bring conversations, group collaboration, voice, files, and devices together in one place.

zh-CN.description: 本地优先的 AI 工作区，支持多 Agent 聊天、编码和可视化工作流。
zh-CN.longDescription: 本地优先的 AI 工作区，支持多 Agent 聊天、编码和可视化工作流。提供桌面应用和可自托管的 Web 控制台，支持 Hermes Agent、Ekko Agent，以及包含 Claude Code、Codex 在内的 14 种 Coding Agent 集成。在同一个工作区中管理对话、群组协作、语音、文件和设备。
zh-CN.name: Ekko Studio
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
更新重点
- 新增 App 与 Studio 的鉴权 P2P 直连，直连不可用时自动回退云端中转 (#3290)
- 改善多网卡和 Docker 环境的 P2P 连接，并修复代理 fake-IP DNS 导致的直连失败 (#3292、#3303)
- 统一模型上下文、推理强度和计费信息识别，改进自定义接口及带前缀模型 ID 的匹配，并优先使用手动设置的价格 (#3298、#3300)
- 修复 App 自定义接口的上下文查询，并为共享会话补充模型别名与推理选项 (#3299)
- 修复刷新或重启后丢失漫画主题选择的问题，加载时恢复已保存的主题风格 (#3302)
- Studio 与桌面端版本同步更新为 0.7.31，前端更新日志补齐 11 种语言并保留最近三个版本 (#3305)
What's Changed
- [codex] add authenticated direct App transport with relay fallback by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3290
- [codex] bind P2P sockets to uplinks and publish Docker UDP ports by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3292
- [codex] unify model metadata and pricing resolution by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3298
- [codex] forward App context endpoints and shared reasoning metadata by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3299
- [codex] match custom model IDs by final path segment by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3300
- [codex] preserve selected theme style on reload by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3302
- [codex] fix P2P STUN resolution under fake-IP DNS by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3303
- [codex] prepare Studio 0.7.31 with localized changelog by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3305
Full Changelog: https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/compare/v0.7.30...v0.7.31
